thread:
michelle: Hi team — quick coordination thread for Priya's upcoming parental leave (Jun 15 start). She asked about phased return options, payroll top-up timeline, and who will cover on-call. Posting checklist + asks so we don't lose anything.

jordan: Thanks, michelle. Two quick Qs: 1) When do we need to submit the formal leave request paperwork to benefits to preserve the paid top-up? 2) Is the phased return (60% for 6 weeks) considered PTO or FMLA-compatible modified schedule?

michelle: Jordan — good Qs. Paperwork deadline: prefer 30 days notice for benefits enrollment/advanced pay processing, but we can accept later with retro coverage in special cases. For the top-up: payroll needs the approved leave dates & manager sign-off by the payroll cut-off for the month before leave begins to guarantee first-pay-period top-up. I'll ping payroll here.

people-ops-bot: Policy link: https://intranet/redwood/leave/policy-parental. Short summary: Redwood offers 16 weeks primary parental leave + up to 8 weeks phased return top-up (manager-approved). Phased return counts as FMLA-compatible modified schedule when documented and approved.

ash: From a team perspective — happy to approve 60% for 6 weeks. We need a coverage plan though: on-call rotation and feature deliverables. Can we propose a temp contractor or shift some work across the team?

jordan: I'll sketch a handoff. Main asks: (a) who picks up the pager, (b) what's the plan for the sprint tasks tagged priya_work, (c) laptop/equipment handoff?

lisa: Equipment: Priya can keep the company laptop during leave if she wants; otherwise we request a return shipping label. For equipment pick-up/return, please file a ticket with IT: #it-asset and mark it "parental-leave-hold".

payroll-bot: Hi — payroll processing note. To guarantee monthly top-up on day 1 of leave: manager approval + signed benefits form (PDF) must be in payroll queue by the monthly payroll cutoff date (typically the 20th). If submission is after cutoff, top-up will start next pay cycle. For retro pay-ups we process with next payroll run once docs are received. Contact payroll@redwood.com for exceptions.

michelle: I'm attaching a short handoff template below — please fill and post to the Team Handoffs doc and @me when done. Also note: if Priya wants the phased return to be part-time (reduced hours) vs. reduced FTE, HR needs weekly schedule to document.

--- handoff template (paste into doc) ---
Owner: Priya Patel
Leave dates: Jun 15 — Oct 5 (primary leave dates)
Phased return: Jun 15 — Jun 30 (example) or actual dates when confirmed
Primary on-call contact: <name> / backup: <name>
Open PRs: list PR numbers + short status
Critical runbooks: link(s)
Blocking tickets: list tickets and owner
Contact during leave: email optional; slack only for emergencies

jordan: Filling this out now. For the on-call, Ash, can you take lead weeks 1–2 and i'll move my sprint tasks to shore up weeks 3–4?

ash: Yep, I can cover weeks 1–2. Jordan — thanks, appreciate the shift. For coverage beyond that, we should coordinate with eng-sre to add 1 extra rotation until backfill is confirmed.

michelle: Great. Final checklist items for paperwork thread: 1) manager sign-off (ash) 2) signed benefits form (Priya) 3) IT ticket for laptop 4) payroll submission before cutoff. If anyone needs me to schedule quick 15m to walk through the form, ping me. :wave: :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Ticket templates: https://intranet/redwood/templates/leave-handoff-template.md

jordan: Done — handoff doc updated and linked in thread. Also attached a short list of critical runbooks. @michelle please confirm if that's sufficient for payroll timeline.

michelle: Confirmed — looks good. I'll mark approvals and send Priya the benefits form today. Thanks everyone! :pray:
